text: さいごに　＊は　＊を　くりだし　＊は　＊で　おうせんした！

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says what was used to do the action. ＊で　おうせんした = 'fought back with ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The bare verb stem links two actions in a row, like the て-form. ＊を　くりだし = 'sent out ＊, and...'.
